reason: addGuests.handler.ts (patch line 592) calls `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` with the raw input instead of `uniqueGuests` (line 498). sendAddGuestsEmails (emails/email-manager.ts, patch line 234) uses `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` to pick the template, so an existing attendee repeated in the input gets AttendeeScheduledEmail instead of AttendeeAddGuestsEmail.
